design: Same eight-rank FP32 RCCL SUM and 25 MiB payload per rank. A/B/B/A changes rank placement only. A is eight ranks in one node. B is four plus four across an owned two-node cohort, with two disjoint eight-rank groups using each pair's 16 cards. A singleton uses only local repeats. Separate topologies by scope in results.
rationale: Measure transport cost before placing training work across allocated nodes. 25 MiB is the fixed bucket cap of the registered Qwen component scope. Full-buffer exact integer-sum checks avoid inferring data-path correctness from timing.
resource_policy: Two external-holder nodes, two MiniCPM reservation nodes and future Qwen node f13r1n10 are excluded from the fresh PCI/KFD-gated scope. Replacement nodes require a new claim.
formal_qualification: Communication component only. No cross-parent group, all-to-all fabric proof, default HAL/Network mode claim or A100 training performance inheritance.
original_grouped_behavior: Closed prior high-priority intra-node experiment. Reuse the reliable physical and process boundaries while measuring a new cross-node topology.
transport_evidence: NCCL initialization and network logs remain private. Attribute transport only to observed runtime messages with their evidence limits.
